summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Binding MOU to acquire a 51% controlling interest in Ultranet Telecom Group for $17.6M total consideration. Payment includes $7M cash at/after closing (structured in tranches) and up to $10.6M deferred earn-out tied to net income targets ($4.5M Yr1, $9.5M cumulative). The acquisition will be via a newly formed UAE holding company, with exclusive economic agreements and call options. Closing conditions include due diligence, regulatory approvals (Ghana NCA, Nigeria NCC), and FCPA audit. Target close: Q3 2026. Watch for definitive agreement execution within 60 days.
